data.long_description:
Avena is where modern living meets the gentle touch of nature. This charming community is designed to offer a sustainable lifestyle situated in harmony with the environment.

Avena 2 offers a selection of 4-bedroom villas. Each home is a symbol of exquisite living, where nature provides the perfect backdrop for an inspiring lifestyle. The architectural design of the villas, presented in three façade styles, focuses on modern elegance. Sleek, clean lines create a stunning and cohesive community.

Avena 2 features an abundance of amenities designed for outdoor recreation and enjoyment. Residents can relax in the landscaped landscaped recreation area, watch movies under the stars in the outdoor theater, and enjoy socializing with loved ones in the outdoor common area. For active lifestyle enthusiasts, there is a swimming pool, gym with fitness area, and children have access to a playground.

With convenient access to the Al Ain Road highway, residents have quick access to the main areas of Dubai. Rugby Sevens Stadium is just five minutes away, Dubai Outlet Mall is 8 minutes away, and Burj Khalifa and Downtown Dubai are approximately 25 minutes away.
